digestNormalization.rationale: Identity stamps are excluded so stamping does not change the digest.

evidenceInvalidation: Evidence is keyed by contract digest, main HEAD at the boundary, vendored file sha256s and the Kubo RPC host. Only evidence whose key changed is invalidated; history is preserved; no blanket re-review.

scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: Same command with wrong credentials returns a 4xx deploy error with code IPFS_AUTH_FAILED and writes no deployment row.
scenarioMatrix.oracle: JSON output has url=https://<gateway>/ipfs/<cidv1>/ and ipfs.ipnsName; the add request carried pin=true, cid-version=1, wrap-with-directory=true, every referenced asset path, and Basic auth; a second deploy reuses key kd-<projectId>.
